{{Quote|We have a problem?''"<br />"''Just a change of plans. Our dirtside friends want us to start the tournament ''now''.|Booster Terrik and Saliah|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Saliah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] serving [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Booster Terrik]] aboard the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' in [[44 ABY]]. She helped relay the communications between the ''Errant Venture'' and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in order to coordinate the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[StealthX]] launch with the ''Errant Venture''{{'s}} [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]] that was set to distract the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Sixth Fleet]] and allow the Jedi to launch.
